mainText: Brighton pick up first away league victory over Man City. Brighton pick up their first away league victory at Manchester City, winning 1-0 to condemn City to a second successive Premier League defeat. Coventry out of bottom three with win over struggling Sunderland. Frank Lampard's Coventry City lift themselves out of the relegation zone after beating struggling Sunderland, who remain rooted to the bottom of the Premier League table. Spurs revival continues with victory over 10-man Crystal Palace. Jean-Philippe Mateta was shown an early red card as Crystal Palace lose 2-0 at Tottenham to increase the pressure on manager Pierre Sage.
